verdict.rationale: A live OpenAPI 3.1 spec is confirmed at /openapi.json with ~405 paths and Swagger UI, satisfying the machine-readable spec download requirement, but there's no documented public developer program or API keys, so it appears to be an internal/bridge API rather than a publicly supported one. missing for 10: documented public API access/keys, developer-facing docs referencing the spec as a supported integration surface.
